title: ข้อสอบคัดเลือกค่าย 1 สอวน. ฟิสิกส์ ปี 2560
subject: ฟิสิกส์
level: โอลิมปิก (สอวน.)
note: 30 questions: part 1 = 1–20; part 2 = 21–30 (printed 1–10). All 30 solvers and generators are present. Normalized solver quantities (cosines, tangents, force ratios) are documented in their modules. Four source ambiguities are recorded on the relevant items. Source readings and full transcript remain in the private bank. Generated diagrams are restated in words because their printed labels change.

Two self-conjugate focal lengths are possible: u*d/(u+d)=30/7 upright; u*(d+R)/(u+d+R)=12 inverted. solve returns INVERTED branch only; generated question explicitly requires inverted image. No unique answer in source.
